issues.description: Method signature mismatch for Milkable.messageOnMilk. The problem statement UML and textual description require a no-argument method messageOnMilk() that returns a String (expected return: "[Animal Type] [name] is milked"). The template Main example calls m.messageOnMilk() with no arguments. The solution repository, however, declares Milkable.messageOnMilk(double volume) and implements messageOnMilk(double) in Goat and Seal. This parameter-list difference will cause compilation and API-usage confusion: code written against the problem/template (no-arg) will not compile against the solution interface (requires a double), and students will be unclear which signature to implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Milkable API consistent across artifacts. Recommended (preserve problem statement and template): change the solution to declare String messageOnMilk() (no parameters) in Milkable, and update Seal and Goat to implement messageOnMilk() returning the specified string format "[Animal Type] [name] is milked". Alternatively, if a volume parameter is intended, update the problem statement UML, textual description, and the template Main example to require messageOnMilk(double volume) and document the expected return format; however, option A is preferred to match the current exercise specification.
